title: Grid-Carbon-Aware Appliance Timing
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=carbon:estimate event=grid
| timechart span=1h avg(grid_intensity_gco2) as intensity
| eventstats min(intensity) as cleanest
| eval clean_window=if(intensity<cleanest*1.2,1,0)
description: Highlights the hours when your electricity grid is cleanest, so you time the dishwasher and car charging to match.
value: Shifting flexible loads to low-carbon hours cuts emissions for free — this shows exactly when to run them.
implementation: Ingest grid carbon intensity into `index=personal`; surface the cleanest hours to run appliances.
visualization: Time chart of grid carbon intensity with clean windows.
grandmaExplanation: It shows when the electricity grid is cleanest, so you run appliances at the greenest times.
